results.title: Dr Philippa Hardman's Post - The AI Magpie Effect - LinkedIn
results.content: The AI Magpie Effect: the existential risk of text-to-content tools for learning designers, educators & learners. TL;DR 📽️ This week, we saw another round of news releases about AI products, including OpenAI's Sora, a text-to-video tool, and Articulate AI which includes text-to-video functionality. I love tools that make us more efficient and reduce the barriers to producing more engaging content but I completely agree that we don’t need more ineffective content. I have been exploring some AI video tools such as InVideo to see if they could add value to the learning content that my team creates, but sitting down with our media assets team I realised the results were not usable at all. While storyboarding and researching content is much quicker with AI tools, the robotic AI voices are extremely off-putting for the learner and the way that stock video footage is edited doesn’t always really make sense to a skilled human video editor.
